verified_claims: Lemma 1: value of the alternating claiming game on a fixed multiset equals odd(S); both pairing strategies and their invariants ('Xiang/Liu never holds both members of a pair') check out, including the M even/odd edge cases
Lemma 2: removing an equal pair p,p from a multiset leaves δ unchanged (adjacent positions in the sorted order, parity of shifted positions preserved)

Theorem 1: geometric opening 2^n/N,...,1/N sums to 1; Lemma E induction verified at base r=1 (two pieces > 2^{n-1} must be disjoint subintervals of the unique part of length 2^n) and in Case 2 (2r pieces each > 2^{n-r} fit in the r parts of length ≥ 2^{n-r+1}, total 2^{n+1}-2^{n-r+1}, even-indexed sum ≤ half)
Piece count M ≤ (n+1)+n = 2n+1, hence r = floor(M/2) ≤ n and even(S) ≤ 2^n - 1, giving Liu ≥ 2^n/N
Theorem 2 pigeonhole: 2^{n+1} subset sums in [0,1] give a gap ≤ 1/N with distinct subsets I≠J; P,Q disjoint nonneg with |σ_P-σ_Q| ≤ 1/N
Cancellation procedure correctness: each pair formed is equal-length, cut step decreases pool size by 1, free step by 2, leftover total length exactly D

Cut count accounting |P|+|Q| = c + 2f + ℓ; if ℓ=0 the last step cannot be a cut step (a cut step returns a positive piece to the larger pool), so f ≥ 1 and total marks |Z|+c ≤ n in all cases, including the degenerate one-sided case
Final evaluation: δ(S) = δ(L) ≤ max(L) ≤ D ≤ 1/N (using δ ≥ 0 on all multisets), so Liu's total ≤ (1+1/N)/2 = 2^n/N
Mark legality: all Xiang cuts are at interior points of current pieces, distinct from Liu's marks and from each other
Sanity check n=1: Liu marks at 1/3, best Xiang reply halves the 2/3 piece giving {1/3,1/3,1/3}, Liu gets 2/3, matching 2^n/(2^{n+1}-1)
summary: The answer 2^n/(2^{n+1}-1) is established by a complete, self-contained argument. The reduction to odd(S) via the two pairing strategies is airtight; the lower bound uses a clean induction on even-indexed partial sums exploiting the powers-of-2 structure; the upper bound combines a subset-sum pigeonhole with a Euclidean-style cancellation procedure whose cut-counting (including the subtle ℓ=0 case) is handled correctly. Degenerate cases (fewer Liu marks, one of P,Q empty, endpoint-wasted marks) are all addressed. No gaps found.
